import heapq

N = int(input())

G = defaultdict(list)
for i in range(1, N):
    a, b, x = map(int, input().split())
    G[i].append((i + 1, a))
    G[i].append((x, b))

dist = [float('inf')] * (N + 1)
dist[1] = 0
q = [(0, 1)]
heapq.heapify(q)
while q:
    current_dist, v = heapq.heappop(q)

            dist[next[0]] = dist[v] + next[1]
            heapq.heappush(q, (dist[next[0]], next[0]))
